title: Nerva Pipeline Configuration
description: Schema for .claude/pipeline.config.json — controls TDD enforcement, database defaults, auth, testing, quality gates, deployment targets, security, API conventions, reporting, and orchestration for the OpenAPI-to-Working-API pipeline.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE validation and autocompletion. Should point at ./pipeline.config.schema.json.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this config controls.

version.description: Semantic version of the config document.

tdd.description: Test-driven development enforcement for the build pipeline (Phase 2 hard gate).

enforced.description: Hard-gate Phase 3 (route generation) on Phase 2 (failing tests) completion.

redPhaseRequired.description: Tests must be confirmed failing (RED) before handlers are written.

greenPhaseRequired.description: Tests must pass (GREEN) before the phase is considered complete.

refactorPhaseOptional.description: Whether the refactor step may be skipped after GREEN.

coverageThreshold.description: Minimum line coverage percentage the TDD phase targets.

integrationTestRequired.description: Every endpoint must have an integration test before its handler exists.

contractTestRequired.description: Responses must be validated against the OpenAPI spec.

testExistenceGate.description: Block route generation until a test file exists for every endpoint.

database.description: Database provider, ORM, connection pooling, and schema defaults.

defaultProvider.description: Database engine the generated API targets.

orm.description: ORM used for schema, queries, and migrations.

connectionPoolMin.description: Minimum idle connections kept open in the pool.

idleTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds an idle connection stays open before being closed.

migrationSafety.description: Review generated migrations for destructive operations before applying.

blockDestructiveMigrations.description: Refuse to apply migrations that drop tables or columns.

softDeleteDefault.description: Generate a deletedAt column and soft-delete semantics by default.

timestampsDefault.description: Add createdAt/updatedAt columns to every table by default.

uuidPrimaryKeys.description: Use UUID primary keys for generated tables.

serialPrimaryKeys.description: Use serial (auto-increment integer) primary keys for generated tables.

auth.description: Authentication and authorization defaults applied by the auth-middleware phase.

defaultStrategy.description: Authentication scheme generated when the OpenAPI spec does not specify one.

jwtAlgorithm.description: JOSE algorithm used to sign JWTs.

bcryptRounds.description: bcrypt cost factor for password hashing.

apiKeyLength.description: Byte length of generated API keys.

rateLimitPerUser.description: Requests per window allowed per authenticated user.

sessionStrategy.description: Whether sessions are stored server-side (stateful) or encoded in the token (stateless).

testing.description: Test framework, timeouts, load testing, and test database strategy.

httpClient.description: HTTP client used by integration tests.

integrationTimeout.description: Per-test timeout in milliseconds for integration tests.

unitTimeout.description: Per-test timeout in milliseconds for unit tests.

contractTestEnabled.description: Run contract tests that validate responses against the OpenAPI spec.

loadTestEnabled.description: Generate and run k6 load tests.

http_req_duration_p95.description: Maximum p95 request duration in milliseconds.

http_req_duration_p99.description: Maximum p99 request duration in milliseconds.

testDatabase.description: How integration tests obtain an isolated database.

alternativeStrategy.description: Fallback isolation strategy when the primary is unavailable.

seedBeforeTests.description: Run the seed script before the integration suite.

qualityGate.description: Criteria that must pass in Phase 7 before deployment config and the report are produced.

typescriptRequired.description: tsc --noEmit must succeed under strict mode.

securityAuditRequired.description: security-scan.sh must report no vulnerabilities at or above the configured level.

coverageThreshold.description: Minimum line coverage percentage enforced at the gate.

maxFixAttempts.description: How many automatic fix-and-retry loops run before the gate fails.

noAnyTypes.description: Fail the gate if any `any` types are present in generated code.

deployment.description: Supported deployment targets and their per-target defaults.

targets.description: Deployment targets the pipeline can generate configuration for.

defaultTarget.description: Target used when build-spec.json does not name one. Must appear in targets.

hyperdrive.description: Bind a Hyperdrive connection pool for PostgreSQL.

nodeDocker.description: Defaults for the node-docker target (Dockerfile, docker-compose).

nodeVersion.description: Docker image tag for the node base image (e.g. "22-alpine").

port.description: Container port the server listens on.

healthCheckPath.description: HTTP path polled by the container health check.

processManager.description: Process supervisor used inside the container.

multiStage.description: Generate a multi-stage Dockerfile (build stage + runtime stage).

awsLambda.description: Defaults for the aws-lambda target (SAM template).

timeoutSeconds.description: Function timeout in seconds (API Gateway caps at 29-30s).

apiGatewayType.description: API Gateway flavour fronting the function.

bundler.description: Bundler used to package the handler.

railway.description: Defaults for the railway target (railway.toml, nixpacks.toml).

healthcheckPath.description: HTTP path Railway polls before routing traffic.

healthcheckTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for the health check to pass.

restartPolicyMaxRetries.description: Maximum restart attempts under the on-failure policy.

autoDeployFromGitHub.description: Deploy automatically on push to the connected GitHub branch.

internalPort.description: Port the app listens on inside the Machine.

healthcheckPath.description: HTTP path Fly polls for Machine health.

autoStopMachines.description: What Fly does with idle Machines.

autoStartMachines.description: Start stopped Machines on incoming traffic.

minMachinesRunning.description: Machines kept running regardless of traffic.

maxMachines.description: Upper bound on Machines under autoscaling.

managedPostgres.description: Attach a Fly Managed Postgres cluster.

autoDeployFromGitHub.description: Deploy automatically from GitHub Actions on push.

cicd.description: Continuous integration and delivery workflow generation.

provider.description: CI/CD platform the workflow is generated for.

runTests.description: Run the test suite in CI.

runSecurityAudit.description: Run the dependency security audit in CI.

runBuild.description: Run the production build in CI.

autoDeployStaging.description: Deploy to staging automatically when CI passes on the main branch.

autoDeployProduction.description: Deploy to production automatically (usually false; use a manual approval).

security.description: Security middleware defaults and audit policy.

enabled.description: Apply rate limiting to every route.

origins.description: Allowed origins. "*" is acceptable in development only.

maxAge.description: Seconds a preflight response may be cached.

level.description: Minimum severity that fails the audit.

failOnVulnerability.description: Fail the quality gate when a vulnerability at or above level is found.

checkLockfile.description: Verify the lockfile is present and in sync.

maxBodySizeKb.description: Maximum request body size in kilobytes.

sanitizeStrings.description: Strip control characters and trim string inputs.

api.description: API response conventions shared by generated routes.

defaultLimit.description: Page size when the client omits limit.

maxLimit.description: Largest page size a client may request.

cursorPaginationAvailable.description: Also expose cursor pagination on list endpoints.

envelope.description: Field names of the standard response envelope.

metaField.description: Key holding pagination and request metadata.

strategy.description: Where the API version is carried.

deprecationHeaderEnabled.description: Send Deprecation/Sunset headers on deprecated versions.

enabled.description: Generate filter parsing for list endpoints.
Generate sort parsing for list endpoints.

defaultField.description: Field used when the client omits a sort.

defaultOrder.description: Direction used when the client omits one.

maxFields.description: Maximum number of sort fields per request.

path.description: Route path of the health endpoint.

includeDbStatus.description: Report database connectivity in the health response.

includeVersion.description: Report the application version in the health response.

reporting.description: Where and what the Phase 9 build report writes.

outputDir.description: Directory (relative to the project root) that receives report files.

buildReportFile.description: Filename of the main build report.

testReportFile.description: Filename of the test results report.

loadTestReportFile.description: Filename of the k6 load test report.

securityReportFile.description: Filename of the security audit report.

includeEndpointInventory.description: List every generated endpoint in the build report.

includeSchemaDiagram.description: Embed an entity-relationship diagram in the build report.

orchestration.description: Phase dependency graph and concurrency for the autonomous pipeline.

enabled.description: Run independent phases concurrently according to the dependency graph.

phases.description: Pipeline phases keyed by name. Names must be kebab-case.

qualityGateSubtasks.description: Independent checks run in parallel inside the quality-gate phase, keyed by name.

showStreamingResults.description: Print each phase result as it completes.

showBatchSummary.description: Print a summary after each concurrent batch.

showSpeedupEstimate.description: Estimate wall-clock savings versus sequential execution.

includeTimeline.description: Include a phase timeline in the final report.

semver.description: Semantic version string (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with optional pre-release and build metadata).

duration.description: Duration string: integer followed by ms, s, m, h, or d (e.g. "30s", "15m", "7d").

urlPath.description: Absolute URL path beginning with a slash.

deploymentTarget.description: A deployment platform the pipeline can generate configuration for.

testDatabaseStrategy.description: How each test run gets an isolated database.

items.description: Resource identifier in category:name form (e.g. "filesystem:schema"). Two phases declaring the same resource cannot run concurrently.

resourceList.description: Exclusive resources a phase or subtask holds while running.

phase.description: One pipeline phase in the orchestration graph.

depends.description: Phase names that must complete before this phase starts.

blocking.description: When true, failure of this phase fails the whole pipeline; when false it is reported and the pipeline continues.

subtask.description: One independent check inside the quality gate.
